title: Bay Area hospices and home-health agencies at one street address
question: Where do several separately certified hospices or home-health agencies give the same street address?
finding: 41 Bay Area street addresses carry two or more separately named hospices or home-health agencies in the November 2026 federal files; 0 involve an agency in the hospice-surge case. 14 telephone numbers are given by more than one agency. Largest: 4075 Evergreen Village Square, San Jose (3 agencies).
how: Street line without suite, unit or floor, upper-cased, with common abbreviations; city must match. Hospices: general information file, Bay Area counties. Home health: agency file, rows in the same cities.
limits: Office buildings and medical towers hold many unrelated agencies; one company often holds a hospice and a home-health licence at one office, which is permitted. A shared address is a reason to read the ownership filings, not a finding. Source note: 4 hospice(s) carry a Bay Area county but a ZIP code outside the Bay Area (for example Reliance Hospice Services, Inc, San Fernando, listed in Alameda County); they are left out.
